title: Uhambo Lokunqumla Ulwandle Olungazolanga
intro: Khawucinge nje umi edekini yenqanawa egcwele kakhulu njengoko amaza enyuka kwaye abasebenzi bephosa amaqashiso ukuze banciphise umthwalo. Umntu oyedwa uhamba phambili, evuma isiphelo esibonakala ngathi sisiphelo, kodwa ubunzulu bube yindawo yokuthandaza nokubuya. Emva kwayo kukho uluntu olulumkiswe ngesohlwayo esizayo, ngaphambili kukho inceba engalindelekanga.
clues: Ndathunyelwa njengomthunywa kubantu abangaphezu kwekhulu lamawaka.
Ndibashiye abantu bam ndinomsindo ngaphambi kokuba ndifumane imvume yokuhamba.
Ndakhwela inqanawa eyayizele ngabantu abaninzi, abasebenzi benza amaqashiso ukuze bagqibe ukuba ngubani oza kuphoswa elwandle.
Ndaphoswa elwandle ndaza ndaginywa yintlanzi enkulu ngoxa ndandinetyala.
Ndimzukisile uAllah ebumnyameni, ndisithi akukho Thixo ngaphandle kwakhe, ndithi ndingomnye wabenzi bobubi.
Ndaphoswa elunxwemeni oluvulekileyo, ndigula, waza uAllah wabangela ukuba isityalo segourd sikhule phezu kwam, baza abantu bam bakholwa baza banikwa ulonwabo okwethutyana.

trial.label: Luluphi Uvavanyo Endijongene Nalo?

outcome.label: Yayiyintoni Isiphumo Sam?
options: Ndisindiswe ngokuzukiswa kwaye abantu bam bakholwa baza basindiswa okwethutyana
Abantu bam bajike baba ziinkawu ngenxa yokuphula iSabatha
Abantu bam baginywe ngumhlaba ngenxa yokuzikhukhumeza
Abantu bam babanjwe kukuvuthuza okukhulu okuvela esibhakabhakeni
